beschreibung:
Landmark of the Tiroler Oberland

Built high above the Inn on a steep rock ridge, Schloss Landeck is the proud landmark of the town of Landeck. The castle complex dates back to the 13th century under the Counts of Tyrol and served for centuries as a seat of justice and administration.

Cultural Centre and Vibrant District Museum

Today the castle houses an important Bezirksmuseum showcasing the history of the Tiroler Oberland, ancient craft traditions, and sacred artworks. The mighty keep also affords glorious panoramic views of the surrounding Alpine peaks.
